tickets.name: The Shot
tickets.note: Grab a plate. Wembanyama wins the tip, gets it right back on the block, and goes to work. Mighty Morant gets a clean look on the first trip and takes it before anybody can blink. Cyclone Collins sees daylight on the opening play and runs right through it. A little cut, a little catch, a little bucket for White. Quicker than a squirrel crossing the highway! Hold my sweet tea!

tickets.name: Dame Time
tickets.note: Four tips go up tonight. Toss, tap, sprint, seal. That's the Wembanyama special. Tip after tip after tip, the man just keeps winning them. The first play for the Trail Blazers has Morant's name written all over it. Hart at a long price, and long prices are where the fun lives. Opening toss, Splash Sharpe skies for it, and the Nets start on offense. The Queen City would be proud of this one.

tickets.name: The Bank Is Open
tickets.note: Four horses in this race. They're off! The Lakers set a screen for Doncic before anybody's broken a sweat, and up it goes. Collins gets downhill on the first possession, and nobody's stepping in front of that freight train. Somebody frame that one! You won't find Lights-Out LaVine on the billboard outside, but you might find him on the scoreboard first. White sets up shop on the weak side and waits for somebody to forget him. Let the good times roll!

tickets.name: The Block
tickets.note: Roll call! The Lakers swing it to Downtown Doncic, and he lets it go without a second thought. The ball's in Collins's hands before the crowd has found its seats. Center jump, Sabonis against the world, and the world is losing. Tougher than a hickory stump! Toss goes up, and Sharpe meets it like they had a lunch date. Nobody blink!

tickets.name: Sky Hook
tickets.note: Tip it off, baby! Tatum for the Celtics, the name you'll be googling at halftime. Morant shakes loose on the baseline and the Trail Blazers find him on their opening trip. Collins gets a step on the opening play and takes it all the way. LaVine is the surprise in the gift bag, and we love a surprise. Shimmy, shake and bake! Bold as brass, and twice as shiny.

tickets.name: Dream Shake
tickets.note: Oh, this one's a stew. Hidden gem alert: Tatum for the Celtics. Sneakier than a possum playing dead! Morant is first off the screen and first to fire. Hurricane Hart is the dark horse in the Knicks barn, and that horse can run. Sky-High Sabonis gets the tip, the Kings get the ball, and the big fella gets position. Ticket's in, nerves are on.

tickets.name: Flu Game
tickets.note: Four games, four tips, one parade. Rocket Reed meets that toss at its peak and steers it straight to the Pistons point guard. Morant gets it in the corner, one dribble, two feet, let it go. Hotter than a tailgate grill! They'll be leaving LaVine open, and he's got the receipts to make 'em pay. Wrecking-Ball White sneaks in for the Celtics like a cat burglar in sneakers. Get the band warmed up!

tickets.name: Linsanity
tickets.note: The whole family's here. Reed gets up so high on the tip he could change a light bulb. Morant waves off the screen, goes one-on-one, and lets it go. Here we go: Sabonis versus the other big, and Sabonis gets there a hair early. Ohhh, it's a party now! It's Sharpe at center court, all elbows and knees and ambition. Strap in. Bumpy ride, beautiful view.

tickets.name: Showtime
tickets.note: Four arenas, one big night. Up goes the ball, up goes Whirlwind Wembanyama, and the Spurs come out running. The Trail Blazers put the ball in Morant's hands to start, and he puts it up. Hotter than the asphalt at a summer cookout! First possession, Collins on the left wing, and he's not here to pass. Cue the confetti cannon!

tickets.name: Bad Boys
tickets.note: Saddle up, partner. Jump ball. Wembanyama wins it, and the Spurs go right back to the paint. Hart is the long shot with a short memory and a quick trigger. White floats to the corner, the defense forgets about him, and that's all it takes. Quicker than gossip at the beauty shop! Here's hoping the basketball gods are in a good mood.

tickets.name: Seven Seconds or Less
tickets.note: Doncic leads the conga line. Doncic hunts that first look like a kid hunting Easter eggs. Hotter than Charlotte pavement at noon! Collins takes the opening swing for the Pistons more nights than not. Sneaky little play here: LaVine, crashing the glass on the first miss. Shake it up and pour it out!

tickets.name: Grit and Grind
tickets.note: Gather 'round, folks. Doncic gets the first touch, gives his man a little shimmy, and fires. Hart is a price you can't ignore and a player they'll forget to guard. Quicker than a jackrabbit in a thunderstorm! Sabonis tips it, the Kings push it, and he rolls for the first look. The porch light's on, come on home, ticket.

tickets.name: Splash Brothers
tickets.note: Road trip! First stop, Tatum. Little-known Tatum for the Celtics, and the little-known guys are the fun ones. Morant catches it off the curl, and you can see the shot leaving before it does. Collins comes off the pin-down, catches, rises, and the Pistons bench is already standing. Like a hummingbird on a sugar rush! Set it, forget it, and pray a little.

tickets.name: Run TMC
tickets.note: Here comes the parade! Tatum catches the defense napping on the very first possession. Tell your friends, tell your neighbors! LaVine cuts backdoor while everybody's busy watching the ball. Keep an eye on Hart, because the defense sure won't. Cross your fingers, cross your toes, cross the street if you have to!

tickets.name: Twin Towers
tickets.note: Fresh out the oven! Ref throws it up, Reed sends it to the Pistons with a smile. Early offense for the Trail Blazers, and early offense means Morant. Hotter than a pepper-eating contest! Here's LaVine, flying under the radar so low he's scraping the parking lot. Lights down low, volume up high!

tickets.name: The Process
tickets.note: Spin the wheel! There's Reed in the circle, long as a summer day, and twice as hot. Sabonis wins the tip, and the Kings run the first set right back through him. White is the kind of guy who scores first and then acts surprised about it. Sneakier than a raccoon at the trash can! Ain't nothing quiet about this one.
